endorsements.name: Hugo Leal Vara
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-41012
endorsements.description: Unauthorized access vulnerability in TCMAN GIM v11 version 20250304. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to determine whether a user exists on the system by using the 'pda:userId' and 'pda:newPassword' parameters with 'soapaction UnlockUser’ in '/WS/PDAWebService.asmx'.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.7)

endorsements.name: Hugo Leal Vara
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-41014
endorsements.description: User Enumeration Vulnerability in TCMAN GIM v11 version 20250304. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to determine whether a user exists on the system.
